summary: v77 mandatory/optional criteria end-to-end tested. Backend: new tests/test_v77_mandatory_optional_criteria.py (17 tests) covers mandatory defaults, min_optional round-trip and validation, clean_answers reporting only mandatory gaps, optional-answered-needs-proof, evaluate with min_optional (optional_summary, 'Not answered (optional criterion)'), preliminary and final result notices with the optional line, a real Gemini AI read of one PDF proof, rejecting an optional proof (bid stays qualified while enough optional passes remain, otherwise disqualified), rejecting a mandatory proof (disqualified), proof-report.pdf content and permissions, commercial opening gated by proof review, auto L1 stored and returned by /comparison/l1/{ref}/latest. All 17 pass, plus v76 (13) and the updated v72/v72c suites (50). UI (Playwright): vendor BidSubmit shows the Mandatory/Optional badges and the rule banner, and a bid was submitted with only the mandatory answer and proof. In the admin Notices criteria editor the crit-mandatory-{i} defaults are right, the min-optional box shows and hides, and the save persists min_optional=1. The Criteria master has the mandatory checkbox. Bidding ops shows auto-l1 card with L1 row, q-optional-{bid_ref} summaries, and the proof-report-pdf button downloads a PDF. Fixed 2 small frontend bugs.

minor.issue: An optional yes/no criterion with proof_required that the bidder answers 'No' still demands a proof upload (v is not None). The frontend criteriaReady behaves the same way. A 'No' answer fails the criterion anyway, so asking for proof makes no sense. The same applies to a mandatory 'No'. Suggest requiring proof only when the answer could pass (for example yes_no == True).

There is a race on optional_summary.passed when two different optional proofs on the same bid are finalised at the same moment. Each request computes passed from the qualification it read earlier and $sets the value, so one decrement can be lost and the bid may not be disqualified. Use $inc with a conditional, or recompute from results after the write.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: teamItem() returned members.length (0) for non-consortium bids, so React rendered a stray '0' under every criterion answer box
FIXED: the 'at least N' input took the full width because inp already includes w-full, which overrode w-20 and broke the sentence across lines

issues: Shows the raw minOptional, uncapped. If min_optional is greater than the number of optional criteria, the text reads 'at least 5 of the 3 optional'; the backend caps the value. Use Math.min(minOptional, opt) or validate max on save.
The narrow sidebar card wraps the bid ref and company name over 3-4 lines; consider a stacked layout in compact mode.

action_items: Decide whether a 'No' answer on a proof_required criterion (optional or mandatory) should still require a proof. Change clean_answers and criteriaReady together.
Make the optional_summary.passed decrement in proof_ai.vote atomic.
Cap the min_optional shown in the bid-criteria-rule banner, or validate min_optional <= number of optional criteria on save.
critical_code_review_comments: bid_opening._open reuses the variable name q for both the Mongo query and the evaluate() result. This is harmless now because the cursor was already created, but it is fragile; rename it.

Switching a row's kind from scored (saved mandatory=false) to must_pass keeps mandatory=false, so the criterion silently becomes optional. The checkbox shows it, but consider resetting mandatory when kind changes.
tender_criteria.py is 777 lines; consider splitting results/notices into their own module.
seed_data_creation: TEST_OPT-* notices, committees, bids, uploads, comparison_runs and notifications were seeded and then fully deleted (including TEST_OPT-UI01/02/03 and the UI-uploaded ui_*.pdf files). DEMO-* data was not touched.
